title: Leave a process killed with kill(2) out of crash notifications

checks.what: omarchy-crash-watch reads COREDUMP_CODE and skips SI_USER kill(2) deaths

knownRed: by-construction: COREDUMP_CODE is ADDED to the jq @tsv field list (diff +14/−2); the base reads only UID/COMM/PID/EXE/SIGNAL_NAME, so the probe grep exits 2 on the golden.
